'''''Valantia muralis''''' is a species of annual herb in the family [[Rubiaceae]]. They have a self-supporting growth form and simple, broad leaves. Individuals can grow to 3.2 cm.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Valantia muralis L. - Encyclopedia of Life|url=https://eol.org/pages/1098468|access-date=2022-02-04|website=eol.org}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Valantia muralis (Wall Valantia) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/RUBI/Valantia_muralis.php |access-date=2022-03-05 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us}}</ref>
